title: Sheafification of the affine conormal wedge section equivalence
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], n a natural number, U an affine open of Y [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and V=i⁻¹U. Put A=Gamma(Y,U), I=(ker i).ideal(U) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], N=i*(ker i) [def-pc-module-pullback], E=exteriorSheaf N n [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], M=conormalExteriorModule A I n [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison], and T=tilde.functor A followed by restriction along the chart isoSpec, pushforward along U→Y, and tensor pullback along i [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. Every Gamma(Z,V)-linear equivalence e between the terminal section modules of E.over V and T(M).over V extends to an isomorphism s:E.over V ≅ T(M).over V whose terminal component equals e on every section. The equivalence e is an explicit parameter; no pure-wedge compatibility assumption is needed.

source.place: Lemmas 26.7.1, 26.7.2(2), 26.7.3(1), and 26.7.4; conormal identification from Tag 01R3(2) and canonical unit from Tag 0096.

proof.text: The inverse-image chart V is affine. The conormal module is quasi-coherent by affine_conormal_sections. Localizing its sections and exterior powers shows that E restricted to V is quasi-coherent, using exteriorSheaf_restrict_iso. The restricted affine model T(M) is pullback of the associated module on U and hence quasi-coherent. Transport the over-site sheaves to module sheaves on V. Full faithfulness of global sections for quasi-coherent sheaves on affine schemes extends e and its inverse: on D(f), send x/f^k to e(x)/f^k. These maps glue and their composites are identities. Transport back to the over-site; its terminal component is e. No wedge formula is used.

theorem exists_selfTor_conormal_wedge_chart_from_sections
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (n : ℕ) (U : Y.affineOpens)
    (e : let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
      let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf N n
      let M := conormalExteriorModule (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
      let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
      ((E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).val.obj
            (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))))) ≃ₗ[Z.presheaf.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))]
          ((T.obj M).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).val.obj
            (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))))) :
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
    let E := Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf N n
    let M := conormalExteriorModule (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    ∃ s : E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ≅ (T.obj M).over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1),
      ∀ x : (E.over (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)).val.obj
        (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))),
        s.hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))) x =
          e x
